title: CASDET: Detecting RAG Hallucinations Considering Attention--FFN Cascade Influence
description: Official implementation and experiment code for CASDET, a training-free method for detecting hallucinations in retrieval-augmented generation. The method constructs a local control state at the FFN input, quantifies the Attention--FFN cascade influence signal with the Logit Lens, and combines influence breadth, depth, and intensity into a response-level hallucination risk score.
